<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Key finding: M block moves opposite to player
# M was at c50-51, player moved LEFT 8 cells to c48-51, M moved RIGHT to c58-59
# Bottom bar changed from Y to P (pink) - related to lower creature proximity

# Let me move player UP towards the upper creature to test the color hypothesis
# Upper creature center O is at r15-17, c20-21
# Player is at r32-35, c48-51

action(['UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP', 'UP'], intent='solve')

seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p'][0]
pb = player['boundary']
prows = [p[0] for p in pb]
pcols = [p[1] for p in pb]
print(f"Player: r{min(prows)}-{max(prows)}, c{min(pcols)}-{max(pcols)}")

# Check M block
M_blocks = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'M']
for m in M_blocks:
    b = m['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    print(f"M: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check bottom bar
print("\nBottom bar:")
for n in seg['nodes']:
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    if min(rows) >= 60:
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  {n['color']}: c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
